name: Miami Valley Packaging Solutions
old_description: Miami Valley Packaging Solutions is focused on providing packaging solutions for our customers primarily through corrugated cartons, shipping and storing materials, corrugated boxes, die-cut, partitions, and other specialty packaging. Our goal is to help our customers grow their businesses—increase revenues, decrease costs, and operate more efficiently.
about:
Miami Valley Packaging Solutions operates from Dayton, Ohio, providing packaging solutions centered on corrugated cartons, shipping and storing materials, corrugated boxes, die-cut components, partitions, and other specialty packaging. The company was founded on the principle of being a solutions provider, a mission reflected in its name.

The firm’s capabilities span custom packaging design, die-cutting, corrugated box manufacturing, and the conversion of plastic corrugated for returnable packaging. An award-winning design department develops unique designs tailored to customer needs, integrating substrates such as plastic corrugated and foam. The company also assembles complete packaging systems, incorporating foam and other materials, and creates custom delivery schedules to align with client requirements. Strategic partnerships extend its material options to include plastic corrugated, foam, and chipboard.

Miami Valley Packaging Solutions serves businesses requiring expendable and returnable packaging, point-of-purchase displays, and retail packaging. Its customer base includes companies seeking creative, cost-competitive packaging solutions across various sectors, though specific industries are not publicly detailed.

The company differentiates itself through its solutions-oriented approach, emphasizing design innovation, strategic material partnerships, and a coordinated service model that manages projects from design through production to delivery. It has earned several industry design awards, underscoring its focus on problem-solving packaging.
